instruction: Candid wedding photograph, medium shot at eye-level. Outdoors on a daytime street with blurred motorbikes in the background. The bride in the white wedding dress (R1) stands on the left, holding a bouquet of white tulips and looking right with a smile. Beside her, the groom in the black suit (R2) stands on the right, looking back at her. Her right arm is linked through his left arm as they stand close together. In the background, a few blurred bystanders are visible near parked motorbikes. The scene is illuminated by soft natural daylight, highlighting the contrast between her bright white gown and his dark suit.
